answer: A bond of 38% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in umber, and shale reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, a hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 25 aliases, and each one needs its own funded dune account. That bill is paid per identity, so 138 aliases cost 243 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
